depiction_rules.notes: Provisional D033 scene-specific continuity contract from the canonical verses and supplied stanza captions; not an approved character master.

visual_bible.face: long, lined face with strong brows and expressive eyes; clearly distinct from Ambarisha
visual_bible.hair: long white beard and grey-white matted hair, gathered high; keep consistent across D033
visual_bible.build: lean, naturally proportioned adult with two attached arms and two legs
visual_bible.clothing: simple muted saffron or warm-cream ascetic cloth, restrained beads
visual_bible.continuity_markers: same elderly face, white beard, matted hair and ascetic clothing; anger and fear expressed through posture without grotesque distortion

anatomy_contract.rule: ordinary attached human anatomy; no extra limbs or cloned bodies
